title: Postcode Dataset
description: This dataset contains a list of postcodes in Malaysia, associated with their respective cities and states. Postcodes are a series of numbers (or letters) added to a mailing address to facilitate the sorting and delivery of mail by postal and courier services. Each postcode is assigned to a specific zone, area, or district, helping to ensure efficient mail delivery.

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: The state in which the city or town is located.

fields.name: city
fields.title: City
fields.description: The city or town associated with the postcode.

fields.name: postcode
fields.title: Postcode
fields.description: The postcode associated with a specific area or district in Malaysia.

methodology: The dataset is compiled annually and includes all recognized postcodes across Malaysia. The data is aggregated from official postal service records to ensure accuracy and comprehensiveness. It is structured to allow easy mapping of postcodes to their respective cities and states.
caveat: This dataset is updated on a yearly basis, and changes in postal codes or administrative boundaries may not be immediately reflected. Users should verify the current validity of postcodes for critical applications.
